claim_boundary: This is a reconstruction of the published GeoGA operators on separately admitted WFLO-GGA problem assets. It is not a reproduction of the unavailable Anholt case.

paper_preserved_controls.selection: roulette wheel proportional to nonnegative AEP
paper_preserved_controls.geometry_mutation: replace one selected turbine with a uniformly sampled free candidate among its five nearest free candidates

declared_reconstruction_controls.duplicate_repair: unique valid indices followed by counter-keyed uniform free-candidate refill
declared_reconstruction_controls.survivor_selection: deterministic best-50 AEP elitism from parents plus evaluated offspring
declared_reconstruction_controls.physical_fes: initial fifty complete layout evaluations consume the first fifty budget units; stop exactly at the requested count

shared_evaluator.implementation: paper-repaired WFLO-GGA C++ Jensen RSS evaluator

parallel_contract.worker_count: all processors visible to the job
parallel_stages: offspring construction, repair, and geometry mutation from a read-only parent generation
parallel_contract.randomness: counter-keyed events independent of worker scheduling
